classification.question_topic: Whether others have seen/walked through a specific recurring gym/locker-room bathroom hallway with green stalls and odd/missing doors

locations.location_name: The Green Gym Bathroom / gym locker room bathroom hallway

qualities.raw_description: Dimly lit locker room; flickering fluorescent lighting; walls are white; floor is grey tile; lockers and bathroom stalls are forest green. Bathroom stalls lined up down a long hallway within the locker room. Some stalls missing doors; others have shower curtains for doors; some stalls have multiple toilets in the same stall; others have only half a door either attached too low or too high. Some toilets varying heights; some on a tile platform (as in image). Sometimes other random people in the bathroom.

interactions.description: Dreamer observes/encounters a long hallway of bathroom stalls inside a locker room with inconsistent privacy: missing doors, shower-curtain doors, half-doors mounted too low/high, and stalls containing multiple toilets; toilets vary in height and some sit on tile platforms.
Sometimes there are other random people in the bathroom.

entities_involved.description: other random people in the bathroom

extraction.extraction_notes: Single primary location described; image appears AI-generated and supports layout details (long central walkway with green partitions and multiple toilets on tile bases). Lighting described as flickering fluorescent; time flow not described but recurrence and 'sometimes' crowding provides limited temporal variability.
